# Howard Stern Returns for New Season of SiriusXM Show, Expands to HBO Max


August 31, 2026 11:00am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_c2a363b47900bf074df35454fc8a11ed/siriusxm/news/2026-08-31_Howard_Stern_Returns_for_New_Season_of_SiriusXM_2295.pdf)


***New season kicks off on Monday, September 14***


***New episodes to air Mondays live on SiriusXM with an adapted streamable version available on HBO Max on Thursdays, starting September 17***


***HBO Max partnership expands “The Howard Stern Show” distribution to world-wide***


**NEW YORK, NY – August 31, 2026 –** Howard Stern and SiriusXM today announced the new season of *The Howard Stern Show,* with new shows airing every Monday, starting on September 14.


For the first time, the “King of All Media” will bring his signature, long-running SiriusXM show to HBO Max by adapting his live SiriusXM show into a streamable episode for HBO Max, along with periodic extras. *The Howard Stern Show* on HBO Max will debut Thursday September 17, with new episodes releasing subsequent Thursdays.


Since joining SiriusXM for a legendary run of over 20 years, Howard has taken subscribers and fans on an unprecedented journey. He is regularly lauded as the best interviewer of our time, inspiration for a generation of comedy, and a can’t-miss listen. During his time with SiriusXM, his fans were along for his climb to network television as a judge on America’s Got Talent, and the best-seller list as author of “Howard Stern Comes Again.” Critics and fans alike loved Howard’s 2022 interview with Bruce Springsteen on HBO Max. Today, Howard’s new series on HBO Max takes him to the pinnacle of prestige television and gives his fans a long-desired “seat in the studio” to see what they just heard. As fans hear his live show on SiriusXM, 40 cameras will capture the conversation for a version of the show then adapted into a streamable episode for HBO Max with periodic extras.


“There’s simply no one like Howard, and the start of his new season is another exciting chapter in an extraordinary run,” said Scott Greenstein, SiriusXM’s President and Chief Content Officer. “For more than two decades at SiriusXM, he’s continued to evolve, surprise audiences and deliver the kind of conversations and moments that only Howard can. We are proud that Howard chose to continue with SiriusXM through 2028 for his exclusive live show and deep library of classic Howard, and that Howard, HBO Max and SiriusXM have now teamed up to create a compelling new video version of his show.”


Additionally on September 14, Howard will unveil a new lineup for his long-time SiriusXM channel Howard 100, including *Wrap Up Wednesday* , an expanded version of Howard’s *Wrap Up Show* hosted by Gary Dell’Abate and Jon Hein, plus new ways to hear his multi-decade library of past shows. The Howard Stern section of the SiriusXM app is also expanding to include “Howard Stern Decades” for instant access to Howard’s content from, or about, the 80’s, 90’s, 00’s and 10’s.


Howard’s legions of long-time and new fans never miss a minute of *The Howard Stern Show* , tuning in to catch all of Howard's comedy, conversations, and commentary with his beloved team including Robin Quivers, Fred Norris and Gary Dell’Abate, the antics of his staff and producers, and regular visits from top celebrities and musicians. Recent guests include Ben Affleck and Matt Damon, Eric Andre, Jack Antonoff, Nikki Glaser, Kate Hudson, Taylor Sheridan, David Spade, Sting & Shaggy, Karl-Anthony Towns, and Eddie Vedder.


*The Howard Stern Show* is available to SiriusXM subscribers in their car, on their phone and connected devices at home with the SiriusXM app.

**About Sirius XM Holdings Inc.**


SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, with a portfolio of audio businesses including its flagship subscription entertainment service SiriusXM; the ad-supported and premium music streaming services of Pandora; an expansive podcast network; and a complete ecosystem of advertising solutions through SiriusXM Media and AdsWizz. SiriusXM offers live, on-demand, and human-curated programming across music, talk, news, sports, and podcasts, and the company reaches approximately 255 million monthly listeners across its platforms. With deep automotive manufacturer relationships and unique spectrum assets, SiriusXM is built to reach listeners wherever they are. The company connects fans to the voices, creators, and moments they love - creating communities where listeners engage, participate, and belong.
